name: Lactaid 4% Milkfat Cottage Cheese (100% Lactose-Free)
whyItWorks: Fresh cultured milk curds treated with lactase enzyme so there is 0g remaining lactose. Provides 13g of complete, highly bioavailable casein protein per 1/2 cup with zero fiber and zero spices. One of the top recovery foods in clinical gastroenterology.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat chilled straight from the container or paired with canned peeled peaches or applesauce.
